proof_body:
by
  intro a b c hab
  have hd : b - a ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hab.symm
  rw [collinear_iff_of_mem (p₀ := a) (by simp)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hv b (by simp)
    obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ := hv c (by simp)
    simp only [vadd_eq_add] at hr hr'
    have hr0 : r ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hab (by simpa using hr.symm)
    have e1 : b - a = (r : ℂ) * v := by rw [hr, Complex.real_smul]; ring
    have e2 : c - a = (r' : ℂ) * v := by rw [hr', Complex.real_smul]; ring
    have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hd (by simpa using e1)
    have hrC : (r : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hr0
    rw [e1, e2, mul_div_mul_right _ _ hv0, ← Complex.ofReal_div]
    exact Complex.ofReal_im _
  · intro h
    refine ⟨b - a, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by simp⟩
    · refine ⟨((p - a) / (b - a)).re, ?_⟩
      have hu : (p - a) / (b - a) = ((((p - a) / (b - a)).re : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        apply Complex.ext <;> simp [h]
      rw [vadd_eq_add, Complex.real_smul, ← hu]
      field_simp
      ring
target_source: ∀ a b c : ℂ, a ≠ b → (Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set ℂ) ↔ ((c - a) / (b - a)).im = 0)
